purpose: Five complete references, two partial components, one conflicting shirt identity and eleven product leads; no game file writes

entries.note: The published 150th-anniversary home combination is old-gold shorts and socks. Orange approximates old gold; alternate match combinations and black detailing are not encoded.

entries.sourceClassification: Local dated 2026/27 full-strip report and official jersey
entries.note: The published Tranmere home strip uses white shorts and white socks. SWOS plain white omits shirt topography and its narrow central blue-green detail.

entries.sourceClassification: Dated 2026/27 Puma full-strip report and shirt archive
entries.note: The current Northampton home strip pairs claret shorts and socks with the claret jersey; brown/claret is the SWOS approximation, with the white turnover omitted.

entries.sourceClassification: Official current club store explicitly names red components plus carry-over shirt archive
entries.note: The current official shop labels both home shorts and socks red and includes the 26/27 third kit. The season catalogue confirms the home shirt is a carry-over; not a new jersey.

entries.sourceClassification: Season-specific Puma full-kit coverage and official club announcement
entries.note: White shorts and royal blue socks complete Chesterfield's first-choice home strip. Gold anniversary branding and collar details are beyond SWOS's palette.

partial.note: Official 25/27 product confirms navy shorts with orange panels. Navy uses the dark SWOS black approximation; current matching socks still unverified.
Club's own 2026/27 launch describes red-and-white hooped socks. SWOS red approximates the equal-colour hoops; shorts still require colour evidence.

conflict.note: REVIEW: Football Kit Archive identifies the white pinstriped shirt as home, while Footy Headlines describes the red-black striped shirt as home; dated Kit Geek match report calls red-black the away shirt and white shorts/socks home components. Do not treat the existing shirt mapping as resolved. Preserve the existing shirt codes pending official confirmation and leave shorts/socks unfilled until the pairing is settled.
